summary: End-to-end Playwright test of the restructured Current Phase home card on Dashboard for grandfathered testuser@test.com (Follicular phase, day 11 of 28-day cycle). All 8 acceptance criteria pass: (1) punchline sourced from shared PHASE_CONTENT ('Preseason hype! She's warming up and ready to move.') — no 'storm has passed' or old descriptions; (2) header shows icon + phase name + punchline; (3) stat row is a 2-col grid (Overall Cycle 'Day 11' + Phase Progress 'Phase 2: Day 6'); (4) History + Predictor buttons are 2-col with icons; (5) Today's Game Plan shows 4 icon-led lines with 4 distinct icon colors (cyan/pink/amber/emerald) mapped to Play-by-Play/Feelings/Prep/Action; (6) brief lines pull correct content from PHASE_CONTENT.briefPlayByPlay/briefFeelings and date-seeded picks from prep[]/action[]; (7) See Full Details opens phase-detail-dialog with punchline + full Play-by-Play paragraph ('Estrogen starts climbing…') + What She Feels (Physical + Mental/Emotional lists) + Prep list + Action list; (8) MoodMap Follicular modal still shows shared punchline and Play-by-Play after data source change. Prep/Action are stable across page reload (date-seeded, no flicker). History dialog opens correctly. AI-personalized tips button present alongside See Full Details in bottom row.
